name: Hanzawa Yumi
source: Tomomi's subordinate and a villain in the heaven route. Master of the water type guardian Wool.  [spoiler]Misato's childhood friend. Was unintentionally responsible for the deaths of her parents and Misato's father. Was taken in by Egubado shortly after.[/spoiler]
